# VoxLabs

> VoxLabs (v3.0.0) is an open-source, local desktop studio (Python + PySide6) for consent-enforced AI voice cloning, emotional text-to-speech (TTS), multi-speaker script/lesson-to-audio production, non-destructive waveform editing, and 8-stage DSP audio enhancement. It includes an optional local FastAPI REST server and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`/mcp` over HTTP and `--stdio`).

## Key Facts & Architecture

- **Product Type**: Native desktop application for Windows 10+, macOS 13+ (Apple silicon), and Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+ / Fedora 39+).
- **License**: MIT (source code).
- **Privacy & Safety**: Local processing. Voice cloning requires explicit, attributed speaker consent (`ConsentService.validate`) before any audio is processed. Revoking consent immediately deletes samples and voice profiles. Every generated audio file is tagged `"AI-generated by VoxLabs"` in metadata.
- **Local TTS & Cloning Engines**:
  - **Piper (`piper-en-us-lessac-medium`)**: 63 MB, CPU/CUDA, fast offline neural TTS.
  - **Kokoro 82M (`kokoro-82m`)**: 330 MB, CPU/CUDA (~1 GB VRAM), expressive built-in voices (`af_heart`, `af_bella`, `bm_george`).
  - **Chatterbox (`chatterbox`)**: 3.20 GB, zero-shot voice cloning + native emotion exaggeration, temperature, and seed control.
  - **Chatterbox Turbo (`chatterbox-turbo`)**: 2.99 GB, faster zero-shot voice cloning (reference sample over 5 s) + temperature and seed control.
  - **Qwen3-TTS 0.6B (`qwen3-tts-0.6b`)**: 4.15 GB, zero-shot voice cloning or 9 built-in voices, in 10 languages; from a source checkout it installs into its own engine environment.
  - **VoxLabs MFCC Voice Profile**: Pitch-matched profile approximation on CPU.
  - **Online Engines (Opt-In Only)**: Microsoft Edge Neural (`edge-tts`) and Google TTS (`gTTS`), disabled unless `allow_online_models` is enabled in Settings.
- **DSP & Audio Editor**: Non-destructive edit list (`audios.edit_ops`) with cut, copy, paste, trim, split, move, duplicate, join, silence insertion, fade in/out, gain, normalize, and 8-stage enhancement (`trim_silence -> denoise -> eq -> compress -> deess -> normalize -> limit -> loudness` targeting BS.1770 LUFS).
- **REST API & MCP Server**: Shared service layer exposed on `127.0.0.1:8942` (`/api/*`, `/docs`, `/mcp`) and over stdin/stdout (`python -m app.api.app --stdio`).
